answer: Locks are written down in comet, expire in hollow, and vine lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 193 aliases thus needs 175 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1478 identities would post 699 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
